question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Utter"** means complete or absolute.
 
• The sentence compares necessity driving invention to order arising from chaos.
 
• **"Utter chaos" **emphasizes the complete lack of order or structure that precedes the invention.
 
• Hence, the correct blank is **'utter.'**

Therefore, The correct answer is** 'Option 1.'**

Correct sentence__: Necessity is an (1) __**irresistible**__ force that compels a man to do things. It stirs the mind so (2) __violently__ that it causes great unrest that continues until the necessity is (3) **__fulfilled__**. As order comes out of (4) **__utter__** chaos so does an invention out of some (5) ________. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Option (2) - Least** means the smallest amount. It doesn't convey the idea of complete chaos.

**Option (3) - Perfect **means without any flaws. "Perfect chaos" is not a logical term, as chaos implies disorder.

**Option (4) - Analytical** means examining something in detail. It doesn't describe the state of chaos but rather a method of understanding it.
